name: @darkfactory/root
description: A modular, Postgres-first, AI-native application foundation.

scripts.types: corepack pnpm --filter @darkfactory/api exec bun run types && corepack pnpm --filter @darkfactory/email exec bun run types && bunx --no-install turbo run types --concurrency=1
scripts.typecheck: bun run types && bun run types:check && bunx --bun --no-install tsc --project tsconfig.json && bunx --bun --no-install civet --config scripts/e2e/civet.typecheck.json --typecheck && bun run typecheck:database-integration && bunx --no-install turbo run typecheck
scripts.lint: bunx --bun --no-install biome lint . && bun run lint:markdown
scripts.auth:schema:check: corepack pnpm --filter @darkfactory/auth exec bun run auth:schema:check
scripts.api:openapi:generate: corepack pnpm --filter @darkfactory/api exec bun run openapi:generate
scripts.api:openapi:check: corepack pnpm --filter @darkfactory/api exec bun run openapi:check
scripts.test: bun run test:unit && bun run test:contract && bun run test:operations && bun run test:integration && bun run test:e2e && bun run test:a11y
scripts.test:contract: corepack pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts --project contract
scripts.test:operations: corepack pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts --project operations --project e2e-helpers --maxWorkers=1 --no-file-parallelism
scripts.test:integration: corepack pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts --project integration
scripts.test:coverage: bun run types && corepack pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts --project unit --project contract --project operations --coverage --maxWorkers=1 --no-file-parallelism
scripts.verify:core: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run auth:schema:check && bun run openapi:check && bun run civet:style:check && bun run typecheck && bun run build && bun run test:unit && bun run test:contract && bun run test:operations && bun run docs:check
scripts.verify:integration: bun run types && bun run test:integration
scripts.verify:graph: bun run graph:check && bun run graph:verify
scripts.verify:browser: bun run test:e2e && bun run test:a11y
scripts.verify: bun run verify:core && bun run verify:coverage && bun run verify:integration && bun run verify:graph && bun run verify:browser
scripts.coverage:update: bun run test:coverage && bun run coverage:generate
scripts.verify:coverage: bun run test:coverage && bun run coverage:check
scripts.deploy:web: bun run deploy:web:validate && corepack pnpm --filter @darkfactory/web exec bunx --no-install vinext-cloudflare deploy
scripts.deploy:web:check: bun run deploy:web:validate && corepack pnpm --filter @darkfactory/web exec bunx --no-install vinext-cloudflare deploy --dry-run
scripts.deploy:web:preview: bun run deploy:web:validate && corepack pnpm --filter @darkfactory/web exec bunx --no-install vinext-cloudflare deploy --preview
scripts.deploy:web:staging: bun run deploy:web:validate && corepack pnpm --filter @darkfactory/web exec bunx --no-install vinext-cloudflare deploy --env staging
scripts.deploy:web:staging:check: bun run deploy:web:validate && corepack pnpm --filter @darkfactory/web exec bunx --no-install vinext-cloudflare deploy --dry-run --env staging
scripts.db:generate: corepack pnpm --filter @darkfactory/db exec bun run db:generate
scripts.db:check: corepack pnpm --filter @darkfactory/db exec bun run db:check
scripts.db:migrate: corepack pnpm --filter @darkfactory/db exec bun run db:migrate
